archetypes.name: resolver-parity
archetypes.rationale: The port must preserve bash resolver edge cases exactly.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Python resolver against the retired bash behavior. Focus on sentinel priority, keepalive parsing, session-id binding, TTL handling, and mtime tie-breaks. Check that tests cover boundary cases without depending on global tmpdir state. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: hook-failopen
archetypes.rationale: Hook regressions can block or slow every Claude session.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Stop and SessionStart hook changes for fail-open behavior under missing jq, missing python3, resolver failure, empty cwd, and set -e. Verify the cheap pre-check really guards Python spawn and uses the same session root formula as the resolver. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: migration-cleanup
archetypes.rationale: Deleted bash surfaces must not leave stale contracts or lint allowlists.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the migration cleanup for stale references to the retired resolver library and harness. Check Makefile, agent-lint, docs, security prose, and migrated-scripts entries for consistency with the Python CLI path. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
